risks.risk: Whether it actually sews/stitches correctly under power (timing, needle alignment, feed mechanism, tension) cannot be confirmed from still photos.
risks.proof: A short video clip of the machine running while sewing a test fabric (showing feed movement, needle motion, and finished seam).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven (worst case: treat as needing service/unknown working condition).

risks.risk: Missing accessories/parts (presser feet, needles, bobbins, thread guides, manuals, power cable, attachments) that affect usability and value.
risks.proof: A clear photo list of included accessories laid out on the floor/table + close-up of the power connection and any included needles/bobbins.
risks.if_unproven: Price as machine only (no accessories assumed).

risks.risk: Potential electrical/control issues (control panel works visually but could have faults; motors/servos may be weak).
risks.proof: Video showing the control panel powering on and responding to settings, plus a continuous run for several minutes.
risks.if_unproven: Price as may require electrical servicing.

risks.risk: Industrial/semi-industrial machines often require correct setup; without knowing the exact model, compatibility and maintenance history are unknown.
risks.proof: A photo of the machine’s nameplate/serial/model label (close-up, readable) and any maintenance/service sticker.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lower end of comparable sewing machines (worst-case fit/unknown model).

proof_requests: Send a close-up photo of the brand/model nameplate and serial number (must be readable).
Send a video of the machine sewing a test piece from start to finish (needle motion + feed + seam quality).
Show what accessories come with it (needles, bobbins, presser feet, power cable, any attachments) in one laid-out photo.
Show a continuous run (at least a few minutes) with the control panel settings visible.
